svg.title: Feature vector versus segmentation mask
svg.desc: Comparison of a 256-dimensional feature descriptor with an image-sized binary mask of zeros and ones.
svg.text: A feature vector is not a segmentation mask
Both contain numbers, but their dimensions, meanings, and uses are different.
No channel has a guaranteed “chair” label.
One membership value per image location
Feature tensor → may support a downstream mask; a feature vector is not itself a mask.
Binary masks are shown here; soft masks can instead store probabilities or confidence values.
Conceptual illustration • Not measured SAM output
